versions.changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-skill-vetter-workflow-helper.

- Introduces a workflow to help users implement, adapt, and validate Skill Vetter-style productivity patterns.
- Supports requests related to bug fixing, setup hardening, safety, reliability, and adjacent skill creation.
- Outputs include tailored artifacts, reusable checklists, and verification notes.
- Follows a step-by-step process to clarify needs, minimize manual work, and validate results.
- Triggered by keywords and scenarios involving productivity, vetting, security, and workflow assistance.
